backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing user profiles, prompts, and categories with authorization checks and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping rich‑text color‑persistence features to associated frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of brief summaries for various frontend utilities, components, and stores used across the app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide outlining steps, logs, and fixes for diagnosing and resolving deployment failures.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, light/dark color tokens, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point setting metadata, favicon links, root div, and loading the main React module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling authentication, prompt filtering/sorting, backend sync, and UI layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Standalone sign‑in screen prompting the user to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: UI bar for toggling favorites and selecting categories, using badges and buttons for filtering prompts.
UI component for adding and selecting categories, including deduplication, paste cleaning, and checkbox toggling.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming and deleting categories with usage counts and confirmation prompts.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides buttons to export prompts/categories and import from a JSON file, syncing changes to the backend.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Generic confirmation dialog using alert dialog components.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Renders action buttons for a prompt including copy, favorite, duplicate, edit, and delete.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Displays sanitized HTML prompt content safely in the UI.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Form dialog for creating or editing a prompt with title, rich text content, categories, and favorite flag.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Grid layout for displaying prompts with categories, preview content, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: List-style view for prompts showing title, categories, full content, and actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Renders a dialog showing a prompt’s title and HTML content for preview. Opens or closes based on props and hides when no prompt is provided.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Displays prompts in a table with categories, dates, and action buttons. Supports click-to-preview via a modal dialog.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Provides a search input with an icon and paste-cleaning logic. Calls onChange for text updates.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown selector for changing prompt sort mode. Emits the selected SortMode to a parent handler.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: UI toggle for switching between list, grid, and table view modes. Highlights the active mode and triggers updates on click.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Builds and validates Internet Identity logout URLs and performs full-page logout navigation. Manages pending logout state via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Returns a fixed post-logout redirect URL containing a required admin token hash.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: Hook that sequences local logout and II provider logout, waiting for identity to clear before navigation. Returns logout function, status, and errors.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: Maps between frontend and backend prompt/category types and exposes CRUD operations through an actor interface. Handles default values for missing backend fields.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Syncs prompts and categories with the backend after authentication, merging local state and exposing save/delete logic. Clears local data on logout and handles backend errors with toasts.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category list with add, rename, delete, and set operations. Enforces trimming and case-insensitive duplicate prevention.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Provides a hook to copy text to the clipboard with modern and fallback methods, exposing copy and copied state.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories as a JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts from a JSON file, validates data, resolves ID collisions, and returns prompts and categories.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines the export data structure and validates imported prompt data.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted text, preferring plaintext and extracting sanitized text from HTML when necessary.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Creates paste handlers that clean pasted text and insert it into inputs or contentEditable elements.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and search query across fields.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique IDs for prompts using timestamps and randomness.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompt CRUD operations, favorites, duplication, and category updates.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by various modes including date, alphabetical order, edits, and favorites.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines Prompt structure and enums for view and sort modes.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML content to collapsed plain text by stripping tags and whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML to keep safe formatting, remove unsafe tags, and normalize font tags to spans.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: A basic rich text editor supporting bold, italic, colors, and cleaned paste handling.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves UI preference data (view mode) to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: Persists view mode changes to localStorage using a React hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, logout, stored identities, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and extensive CSS variables for theming in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept for compatibility; favicon handling now occurs via static index.html tags.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it in React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including support for hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current state, issues, and feature requests, focused on preserving and displaying text color formatting in prompts.
